endangerment.comment: Chinese, Wu (wuu-NOCODE_Wenzhou) = 5 (Developing). Language of recognized nationality: Han.

hh_ethnologue_comment.comment: The Sinitic variety of Wenzhou and surroundings is traditionally counted as a divergent Wu dialect and hence subsumed in the Wu Chinese [wuu] entry in E16/E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29. However, Wenzhou is not intelligible to Suzhou (a North Wu dialect) by any measure (**hh:hv:Tang:Chinese**, **hh:d:Chen:Wenzhou**:1-2) and thus merits a seperate entry. See also: Wu Chinese [wuu].
